```sql
SELECT DISTINCT p."ID", p."SEX", date_trunc('year', p."Birthday") AS "Birthday"
FROM main."Laboratory" l
JOIN main."Patient" p ON l."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE l."GOT" >= 60
  AND l."Date" >= '1997-01-01' AND l."Date" < '1998-01-01'
ORDER BY p."ID";
```
